sections.heading: Strategic Intent and Positioning
sections.body: Between 2026 and 2028, Orion Industrial Solutions will reposition itself as a premium, sustainability-led platform serving mid-market and enterprise clients across North America and Western Europe. Our ambition is to increase revenue from €1.2 billion in FY2025 to €1.75 billion by FY2028 while expanding adjusted EBITDA margins from 14.8% to 19.5%. The strategy centers on profitable growth, disciplined capital allocation, and brand elevation anchored in low-carbon products and lifecycle service excellence.

sections.heading: Growth Ambitions by Business Unit
sections.body: The Advanced Materials division will target 9–11% annual organic growth through premium product launches and selective price optimization, supported by two bolt-on acquisitions in specialty composites. The Smart Systems unit will prioritize recurring revenue expansion, aiming to increase service contracts from 38% to 55% of segment revenue by 2028. Meanwhile, Global Distribution will streamline its footprint, exiting three subscale markets and reinvesting in digital channels to improve inventory turns from 4.2x to 6.0x.

sections.heading: Capability Investments
sections.body: We will allocate approximately €210 million over three years toward differentiating capabilities, including a new Sustainability Innovation Center in Rotterdam and enterprise-wide ERP modernization. Digital enablement initiatives will deploy advanced demand forecasting, AI-assisted design tools, and end-to-end supply chain visibility to reduce lead times by 20%. Talent investments include upskilling 1,500 employees in sustainable engineering and launching a leadership accelerator for high-potential managers across all regions.

sections.heading: Sustainability and ESG Commitments
sections.body: A cornerstone of our repositioning is achieving a 45% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by the end of 2028 relative to the 2024 baseline. All new product development will adhere to eco-design standards, targeting a minimum 30% recycled or bio-based input materials where technically feasible. We will publish audited annual sustainability disclosures aligned with the CSRD framework and link 20% of executive variable compensation to verified environmental and safety metrics.

sections.heading: Performance Milestones and Governance
sections.body: Quarterly performance reviews will track revenue growth, gross margin progression, free cash flow conversion (target: >85%), and return on invested capital (target: 18% by 2028). A cross-functional Transformation Steering Committee, chaired by the CFO and Chief Sustainability Officer, will oversee milestone delivery and risk mitigation. Key 2026 milestones include completion of ERP Phase I, closure of two underperforming facilities, and launch of the premium "Aurelia" product line in Q4.

structure.full_text:
2026–2028 Corporate Strategic Plan Overview
Ref: CSP-26-28 | Date: 12 January 2026 | Prepared by: Strategy & Transformation Office

Section Strategic Intent and Positioning
Between 2026 and 2028, Orion Industrial Solutions will reposition itself as a premium, sustainability-led platform serving mid-market and enterprise clients across North America and Western Europe. Our ambition is to increase revenue from €1.2 billion in FY2025 to €1.75 billion by FY2028 while expanding adjusted EBITDA margins from 14.8% to 19.5%. The strategy centers on profitable growth, disciplined capital allocation, and brand elevation anchored in low-carbon products and lifecycle service excellence.

Section Growth Ambitions by Business Unit
The Advanced Materials division will target 9–11% annual organic growth through premium product launches and selective price optimization, supported by two bolt-on acquisitions in specialty composites. The Smart Systems unit will prioritize recurring revenue expansion, aiming to increase service contracts from 38% to 55% of segment revenue by 2028. Meanwhile, Global Distribution will streamline its footprint, exiting three subscale markets and reinvesting in digital channels to improve inventory turns from 4.2x to 6.0x.

Section Capability Investments
We will allocate approximately €210 million over three years toward differentiating capabilities, including a new Sustainability Innovation Center in Rotterdam and enterprise-wide ERP modernization. Digital enablement initiatives will deploy advanced demand forecasting, AI-assisted design tools, and end-to-end supply chain visibility to reduce lead times by 20%. Talent investments include upskilling 1,500 employees in sustainable engineering and launching a leadership accelerator for high-potential managers across all regions.

Section Sustainability and ESG Commitments
A cornerstone of our repositioning is achieving a 45% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by the end of 2028 relative to the 2024 baseline. All new product development will adhere to eco-design standards, targeting a minimum 30% recycled or bio-based input materials where technically feasible. We will publish audited annual sustainability disclosures aligned with the CSRD framework and link 20% of executive variable compensation to verified environmental and safety metrics.

Section Performance Milestones and Governance
Quarterly performance reviews will track revenue growth, gross margin progression, free cash flow conversion (target: >85%), and return on invested capital (target: 18% by 2028). A cross-functional Transformation Steering Committee, chaired by the CFO and Chief Sustainability Officer, will oversee milestone delivery and risk mitigation. Key 2026 milestones include completion of ERP Phase I, closure of two underperforming facilities, and launch of the premium "Aurelia" product line in Q4.

Confidential — Internal Use Only | Page 1 of 4

structure.heading: 2026–2028 Growth Ambitions and Market Positioning by Business Unit
text_content: **2026–2028 Growth Ambitions and Market Positioning by Business Unit**

Over the 2026–2028 planning horizon, the company will accelerate growth to achieve clearly defined financial targets: by FY2028, total revenue will reach $3.2B (from $2.4B in FY2025) and by FY2028 the consolidated EBITDA margin will reach 18% (from 14% in FY2025). These targets reflect a compounded annual growth rate in revenue of approximately 10% and a disciplined margin expansion driven by portfolio optimization, pricing, and productivity gains. Quarterly metrics and board reviews will monitor progress against these milestones. Investments will prioritize scalable platforms, capacity, and customer success.

In 2027, we will enter two new countries: Germany and Japan, establishing local entities and regulatory frameworks to support product launches and channel development. Market entry will follow a phased sequence: establish legal presence and compliance, recruit sales and service teams, and secure initial anchor customers in manufacturing and enterprise technology segments. Germany will serve as our European hub for advanced manufacturing accounts; Japan will prioritize strategic partnerships in automotive and consumer electronics. Performance gates in H1 and H2 2027 will determine investment pacing and scale targets.

Business unit-level ambitions are differentiated to capture market opportunities and margin improvement across three primary units: Products, Services, and Cloud. Products targets include a 12% CAGR in FY2026–FY2028 through accelerated R&D, internationalization, and higher-margin modular offerings. Services will focus on cross-selling, lifting attach rates by 25% and improving utilization to increase operating leverage. Cloud aims for 40% annual recurring revenue growth with strategic partnerships for infrastructure and software-as-a-service distribution. Each unit will maintain bi-annual KPIs tied to revenue, gross margin, customer retention, and product roadmap delivery targets.

To realize margin expansion and sustainable market positioning, we will implement targeted go-to-market and operational initiatives emphasizing scale, automation, and strategic alliances. Key measures include: 1. consolidating procurement to capture at least 150 basis points of cost savings; 2. migrating 60% of enterprise customers to standardized service tiers to reduce delivery complexity; and 3. pursuing selective M&A to acquire complementary capabilities and accelerate time-to-revenue. Execution milestones are set quarterly, with FY2027 as a pivotal year for integration and FY2028 to reflect full run-rate contribution to profitability targets.
